about.title: About me
paragraphs: I got serious about building web applications while studying for my associate degree in Informatics Engineering at Politeknik Negeri Bandung. I now work as a Junior IT Consultant at PT Global Dinamika Informatika, building internal applications for corporate clients.
What I enjoy most is taking work that has always been done by hand, like documents passed from desk to desk or permits tracked in Excel, and turning it into a tidy system that runs on its own.
Outside of work, I also take on freelance projects.
about.education: Associate Degree (D3) in Informatics Engineering · Politeknik Negeri Bandung (2020–2023)

points: Led development of RFA, an online document approval app, as lead developer and sole person in charge, after joining as a developer on a two-person team.
Built a multi-level approval flow with delegation and automatic reminders, replacing documents that used to be passed around by hand.
Developed PED, a company permit tracking app, with a three-person team over 12 months, including automatic renewal reminders and faster-loading data pages.
Built an employee data management app for an educational institution in Bandung.
Turned interface designs into dashboards for each user role, complete with reports and charts.

rfa.title: RFA — Request for Approval
rfa.desc: An online document approval app. Requesters submit documents, managers approve them step by step right in the browser, and can assign a stand-in when they're away. Automatic reminders make sure no document gets stuck.

ped.title: PED — Permit Digitalization
ped.desc: One place to track every company permit and its expiry date. The system reminds the person in charge before a permit expires, so renewals no longer slip through.
